test_pairwise_iou_rotated: test pairwise_iou_rotated to compute IoU between two sets of rotated bounding boxes on CPU or CUDA
test_RotatedBoxes_clip: test RotatedBoxes clip method to clip rotated boxes to a given image size with angle threshold
test_RotatedBoxes_normalize_angles: test RotatedBoxes normalize_angles method to normalize rotation angles to the range of -180 to 180 degrees
test_pairwise_iou_structure: test pairwise_iou function to compute IoU between two RotatedBoxes objects with arbitrary rotation angles
test_RotatedBoxes_scriptability: test RotatedBoxes TorchScript compatibility by scripting area computation and box concatenation operations
